description: This file defines functions for building Downlink Control Information (DCI) messages for various Radio Network Temporary Identifiers (RNTIs) in a 5G NR scheduler, including functions for different RNTI types and message formats.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_si_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI format 1_0 for SI-RNTI used in SIBs.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_p_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI format 1_0 for P-RNTI used in PCCHs, with overload for short messages.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_ra_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI format 1_0 for RA-RNTI used in Random Access Response.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI format 1_0 for TC-RNTI, used in Msg4.

methods.name: build_dci_f0_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Constructs DCI format 0_0 for TC-RNTI, used in Msg3 retransmissions.
